title: Vault never says sync is off or unpaired
what: Vault reads the vault sharing switch once and uses it only in the empty state. Vault sharing is off by default. With one item in the vault, the header shows only New and Lock. The screen never reads paired or connected computers. The empty state with sharing off opens Sync sharing, never pairing; with sharing on it has no sync button at all. Vault also syncs only while it is unlocked on the phone, and no screen says so.
risk: You add one login on the phone and wait for your computer's passwords. They never come. Nothing says the switch is off, that no computer is paired, or that Vault must be open here.
rec: Port the desktop header control (SyncCategoryAction) into the Vault ScreenHeader: off = one tap turns it on (the call already exists in Sync sharing), on = opens Sync sharing, no paired device = opens Sync to pair. Use the same control in the empty state. Add one line: 'Syncs while Vault is open here and on your computer.'

title: Notes shows no sync state; its copy is wrong
what: Notes and Note read nothing from sync. The empty state says notes 'stay on this device', while notes sharing is on by default. Delete dialogs always say 'here and on your paired devices', even with sharing off or no computer paired.
risk: You cannot tell whether a note reaches your computer, and you cannot turn sharing on or pair from Notes. The text says the opposite of what happens.
rec: Same header control as Vault, bound to the notes category. Make the 'paired devices' clause conditional, as the Vault item screen already does ('when Vault sync is on').

screen: Pro page (after expiry redirect), Settings Pro row
title: Expired or removed licence lands on the sales page
what: When the licence expires or this phone is removed from it, the app resets to the Pro page. That page shows the same sales content as for someone who never bought. The 'expired' flag is read only by the redirect, never by a screen. The key sheet opens empty.
risk: In the middle of a task the app jumps to a price page. Nothing says 'your licence expired' or 'this phone was removed from your licence'. There is no Renew or Reactivate button.
rec: On the Pro page, when the expired flag is set (or a saved key has no access), show one line above the button and relabel it Renew or Reactivate this phone. The offline note on the same page is the pattern to copy.

title: No way to enter a licence key while online
what: Every Get Pro button opens the web checkout. The page with 'I have a license key' opens only when offline, from a web link, or on expiry. The Pro tab shows its licence row only when licensed. Its one buy control is a banner; dismissing that banner (here or in Settings) removes it for good.
risk: Someone who bought on the computer, or paid and closed the sheet, sees only Get Pro. After dismissing the banner, the Pro tab has no way to buy or activate at all.
rec: Show the Pro tab licence row for unlicensed users as 'Enter licence key', opening the Pro page with the existing unlock param. Keep a fixed Get Pro row on the Pro tab that ignores the dismissed flag.

title: Voice input errors are made but never shown
what: The code builds messages such as 'Couldn't hear that' and 'Couldn't load the voice model, free some memory'. They go only to the mic button, which takes the error and never draws it. A speech model download started from the mic logs its failure and shows nothing. 'Transcribe again' with no usable model gives an OK-only alert that says to download a model in Models.
risk: You speak, the spinner stops, nothing appears. No reason and no retry. A failed download just puts the mic back to its unavailable look.
rec: Draw the error in the line above the composer that already shows the transcription notice. For the memory case use the existing model failure card (Free memory and retry). For the download and 'Transcribe again' cases open the existing speech model picker sheet.

title: Sync that fails to start shows 'Loading...' forever
what: A failed start stores its reason, and the shared view model exposes it as local.error. No screen reads it. The pairing code shows 'Loading...', and Show QR, Scan and Rescan are disabled.
risk: Three grey icons and 'Loading...' with no reason and no retry. Pairing is impossible and you do not know why.
rec: Show local.error with a Retry that starts sync again, in the card the Sync screen already uses for licence reconciliation.

title: Local Network refusal and no Wi-Fi are never named
what: iPhone: the app declares the Local Network permission but never detects a refusal. Discovery errors are only logged. The texts say 'check the network'. With saved devices the status line is hidden, so the computer just reads 'Offline'. Both platforms: a helper that checks for Wi-Fi exists, and nothing in Sync calls it. The Remote servers scan has the same blind spot.
risk: After one tap on 'Don't Allow' on iPhone, the computer is offline forever and the app blames Wi-Fi. On mobile data every device reads 'Offline' with no word that this phone is not on Wi-Fi.
rec: On iPhone add 'Settings > Off Grid AI > Local Network' and an Open Settings button to the could-not-reach and nothing-found lines (the clipboard permission sheet already has this block). Add one line 'This phone is not on Wi-Fi' in the Devices card when the Wi-Fi check fails.

title: Saved chat image lands where you cannot open it
what: iPhone: Save copies the image into the app's own documents folder and says 'Saved to <file name>'. The app does not expose that folder to Files, and it is not Photos. Android: the storage permission answer is ignored, and a failure shows the raw system error. Both alerts have OK only.
risk: iPhone says 'Image Saved' and the picture is in neither Photos nor Files. On Android a refusal ends in a system error string with no way forward.
rec: Use the path the Gallery already uses: the share sheet on iPhone and the media export service on Android (the one video save uses). On a permanent refusal offer Open Settings.

title: 'Take photo' does nothing without camera permission
what: Take photo calls the camera and reads only the picture. It never reads the error code and never asks for camera permission. On Android the picker refuses when the permission is declared but not granted, so nothing opens. On iPhone a refused camera is not reported to the app.
risk: On Android you tap Take photo and nothing happens, unless you once allowed the camera in the QR scanner. On iPhone there is no message and no path to Settings.
rec: Ask for the camera permission first on Android. On refusal show the same 'Cancel / Open Settings' alert the mic button and the QR scanner already use.

title: A 'try it' button drops you out of onboarding
what: Onboarding step 3 opens the normal guide topic page. Its action button is live. On a new install 'Start a chat' goes to the Models tab and 'Open Projects' goes to the Projects tab. Onboarding is marked done only by its own finish step.
risk: You land in the tabs with no model and no setup. On the next launch onboarding starts again.
rec: Pass a preview param from onboarding and hide the action button on the topic page, or make the action finish onboarding first.

title: 'Not enough space' has no path to free it
what: A download that does not fit shows an OK-only alert: 'Free up space in Settings > Storage'. Failed rows in Downloads offer only retry and delete. The Storage screen shows model counts as plain text; only video packs can be deleted there. Its last line says to delete models 'in Models', as text.
risk: You read 'free up space', tap OK and must find Storage yourself. Storage then sends you to another tab. Retry fails the same way.
rec: Add a 'Free up space' button to the alert and the failed row (the start-picture sheet already has this exact button). On Storage, make the model rows and the last line open Downloads, where each model can be deleted.

title: No model: 'go to Models', no button
what: With no model, the chat screen and the Chats list say 'Download a model from the Models tab' and show a button only when a model exists. 'No Model Selected' alerts on send, resend and edit have OK only. The Project page hides 'New chat' and still says 'Start a chat'.
risk: A new user reads a sentence that names another tab and has only Back. On a new project there is no button and no reason.
rec: Give each empty state a 'Get a model' button to the Models tab (the route is already used in chat). Give the alerts a 'Choose model' button that opens the model picker.

title: No image model: OK-only alerts, picker has no Browse
what: Turning on Image mode with no image model shows 'Download an image generation model from the Models screen' with OK only. The model picker inside chat is opened without the browse action, so its Image tab says 'Download image models from the Models tab' with no button. The Gallery empty state says 'Generate images from any chat' and does not check for an image model.
risk: Three places tell you to go to another screen and none takes you there. Video mode beside it already has 'Get a video model'.
rec: Copy the video path: a 'Get an image model' button to the Models tab on the Image tab. Pass the browse action to the chat's model picker, as the Chats list already does. Same button in the Gallery empty state.

title: Film screens name the missing piece, offer no button
what: With no video model and no computer, Story and Animate show one line: 'Choose a video model in Models, or pick your computer.' A place that cannot be used is a disabled pill with a reason only. A film that fails because the computer is not reachable shows the two fixes as text and only 'Try again'. Narration with no voice shows a small grey line while the mic still reads 'Narration on'.
risk: You wrote a storyboard and have nothing to tap. The film can also come out with no voice.
rec: Add two buttons, 'Get a video model' (Models, Video tab) and 'Connect your computer' (the start-picture sheet already has it). Make the narration line a row that opens Models on the Voice tab.

title: Home picture and clip cards can do nothing
what: With an image or video model downloaded, the card calls 'start new chat'. That returns without a word when no model is active (for example after 'Eject all'). When it works, it opens a plain chat, not picture or video mode.
risk: You tap 'Describe a picture', feel the tap, and nothing happens.
rec: Reuse the guide's opener: it opens the chat in image or video mode, or the right Models tab when the model is missing.

title: Desktop tools switch silent when computer offline
what: The switch sends a request to the computer and ignores whether it was sent. The row never reads which computers are connected. With no paired computer the whole section is hidden. An unreachable computer shows 'Not reachable' with a disabled row, and its tools page offers only 'Go back'.
risk: You flip the switch for an offline Mac and nothing changes, with no reason. With no computer paired, the phone never mentions that it can run tools on a computer.
rec: Read the connected list in the row (the task card already does). When offline show 'Offline. Open Off Grid AI on <name>.' and make the row open Sync. With no paired computer show one row 'Pair a computer'. Add an 'Open Sync' action beside 'Go back'.

title: Computer offline for a task: red text, no button
what: The task card says '<name> is offline' as plain text and keeps Pause and Stop live. A failed task shows 'Reconnect <name> and try again' as text. Resend with Assistant on shows 'Connect an active Desktop' with OK only. 'Desktop tasks unavailable' says 'Allow remote tasks on the Desktop' with OK only and does not name the setting.
risk: You get a red sentence and must find Sync yourself. A failed task has no retry.
rec: Make the offline line a row that opens Sync and disable the controls while offline. Reuse the composer's 'Set up Sync' action in the two alerts, and name the exact computer setting.

title: Tools row shows 'N/A' and the tap does nothing
what: When the model cannot call tools, the Tools row shows a grey 'N/A' badge. A tap closes the menu and opens nothing. This row is the only way to the Tools screen.
risk: Web search and the other tools seem to be missing. There is no reason and no way forward.
rec: On tap show one line, 'This model can't use tools', with a 'Choose model' button that opens the model picker.

title: Clipboard ignores pairing and iPhone paste permission
what: Clipboard has its own switch and reads nothing about paired computers. The empty text is always 'shows up here once Clipboard sync is on', even when the switch is on. iPhone: the paste permission guide opens only from Sync sharing, and only the first time.
risk: Switch on, list empty, and the text tells you to turn on what is already on. With no computer paired, nothing says so. On iPhone, after one 'Don't Allow Paste', nothing is captured and no screen shows the fix again.
rec: Three empty texts: off; on with no paired computer plus a 'Pair a computer' button to Sync; on and waiting. On iPhone mount the existing paste guide sheet here and keep a 'Paste access' link under the switch.

title: Licence key errors give no next step
what: The sheet shows only the error title and text: 'This license has expired', 'invalid or revoked', 'could not be registered', 'Remove it from your devices and try again'. The only other control is 'Not a member yet? Get Pro'.
risk: An expired key has no Renew. Other errors have no support contact. 'Remove it from your devices' points to a screen an unlicensed phone cannot open.
rec: One action under the error: Renew (the checkout) for expired, 'Contact support' (the support email helper Settings uses) for the rest.

title: After activating Pro: 'Got it' and nothing else
what: Success shows 'Pro is active on this device' and 'Got it'. The licensed Pro page lists three features (Sync, Clipboard, tools); the Pro tab lists eight. Onboarding promised 'Pro features start once you have Pro. Your picks are kept', but nothing sets up the models for those picks after activation.
risk: You just paid and see a tick and three rows. Notes, Vault, Video and Voice are not named. The Pro features you picked still have no models.
rec: Build the 'Included with Pro' list from the same source as the Pro tab. When Pro picks exist, add 'Set up my Pro picks' to the success card, opening the existing auto setup.

screen: Pro tab, Guide, Home, share from another app
title: Scribe opens Notes; shared text hits a bare paywall
what: The Scribe guide topic and the Home 'clearer writing' card both open the Notes list. The real screen is called Improve. Without Pro, text sent to Improve from another app is dropped and the general Pro page opens, with no line about Improve.
risk: You tap Scribe and land on a list of notes with nothing called Scribe or Improve. Without Pro you select text in another app and get a sales page with no reason, and your text is gone.
rec: Point the Scribe entries at the Improve screen with sample text and label the button 'Try Improve'. Without Pro, open the Improve guide topic (it says Pro and has Get Pro) in place of the general Pro page.

title: Photo on a non-vision model: OK only
what: Attaching or sending a photo on a model without vision shows 'Switch to a vision-capable model' with OK only. At send time the missing-vision-file case says 'Open Downloads and tap the wrench' with no button, although the composer version of that alert has 'Open Downloads'.
risk: You are told to switch model or open Downloads, and the only button is OK.
rec: Add 'Choose model' (opens the model picker, as the memory alert does). Reuse the composer's alert builder at send time so 'Open Downloads' is there too.

title: 'Tap to speak' ignores mic and speech model state
what: The large mic in Voice mode only toggles recording. It does not check the microphone permission or whether a speech model is installed. Only the small footer mic shows the true state.
risk: With the mic refused or no speech model, the big 'Tap to speak' does nothing.
rec: Drive the large mic from the same state as the footer mic and reuse its two alerts (Open Settings, Download voice model).

title: 'Couldn't read' a file: no reason, no retry
what: A file that fails to read is labelled 'Couldn't read'. The stored reason is never shown, and failed files are never tried again. The preview shows a red sentence with only Back. The Files error card has Retry, but it reopens the file picker and keeps only the last failure.
risk: A failed file sits in the list with two words. You cannot see why or try again without finding the file a second time.
rec: Show the stored reason as the row's second line. Add 'Try again' that restarts reading for that file, in the row and in the preview error state.

title: Forgotten app passphrase: no way out, no warning
what: The lock screen has one field and Unlock. After five misses it shows a five-minute timer. There is no 'Forgot passphrase'. Setup never says the passphrase cannot be recovered.
risk: A forgotten passphrase locks you out for good, and nothing tells you what that means or what to do.
rec: One line at setup: 'If you forget it, the only way back in is to erase the app's data.' A 'Forgot passphrase?' link on the lock screen that says the same.

title: Three features go quiet when a permission is refused
what: Film: the notification permission answer is thrown away, and the screen always says 'We send a notification when it is ready'. Screenshot sharing (Android): a refused photo permission makes the watcher return, and the rule still reads as on. Calendar tools: a refusal becomes the tool error 'Calendar permission denied', and the tool switches show no permission state.
risk: You leave the app and no notification comes. Screenshots set to Auto never send. Every calendar request fails. None of the three offers Settings.
rec: Keep each permission answer. When refused, show one line ('Notifications are off', 'Allow photo access', 'Calendar access is off') with an Open Settings button, as the mic button does.

title: Image and video downloads lack 'use it now'
what: A finished text model offers 'Chat now'. A finished image model shows '<name> is ready' with OK only. A finished video model shows nothing. An imported model says 'imported successfully' and is not selected. Video model errors (no space, another pack installed) appear as red text under the whole list.
risk: After a multi-gigabyte download you must work out where to make a picture or clip. A failed video download looks like nothing happened, because the reason is below the cards.
rec: Reuse the text pattern: 'Make an image', 'Make a video' (the chat opens in that mode), and select an imported model with 'Chat now'. Show video model errors in the alert sheet the card already has.

title: iPhone with no passcode: Vault says 'Try again' forever
what: The message 'Set a passcode on this phone to use Vault' is thrown only when the keychain call returns false. On an iPhone with no passcode the keychain rejects, so the screen shows 'Vault stayed locked. Try again.' There is no Settings button in either case. (The reject path was read in the keychain library, not run on a device.)
risk: Unlock, 'Try again', unlock, in a loop. You are never told that a passcode is needed.
rec: Map the keychain rejection to the passcode message, and add Open Settings beside Unlock.

screen: Pro tab, Guide, Settings, Pro page
title: Sync and Pro tools go by three names each
what: The screen and the Settings row are called 'Sync'. The guide button says 'Open Devices', and the Pro tab row is 'Your chats, on every device'. The Pro tab row 'MCP tools' has the button 'Open Tools' and opens a screen titled 'Pro tools'; a separate free screen is titled 'Tools'. The licence row promises 'Devices, renewal and restore': renewal is plain text and restore does not exist.
risk: Someone looking for 'Sync' in the Pro tab finds no row with that word. 'Open Devices' opens a screen called Sync. 'Restore' is promised and absent.
rec: Use one name per screen: 'Open Sync', 'Open Pro tools', and a mobile label 'Sync' for the Pro tab row (the label override exists). Change the licence row to 'Devices and renewal', and make 'Manage subscription' open the support email.
